# The Stars That Whisper in the Dark

## Scripture
"He counts the stars and calls them all by name. Great is our Lord and mighty in power; his understanding has no limit." - Psalm 147:4-5

## Reflection
On a clear September evening, the constellation Lyra rises like a harp strung across the heavens. Its brightest star, Vega, has been a faithful beacon for millennia—yet astronomers tell us it's actually rushing toward us at nearly 8 miles per second. One day, it will pass us by and continue on its journey.

We often think of stars as fixed and permanent, but they are in constant motion. Some, like Vega, hurtle through space. Others pulsate, dim and brighten, or drift in gravitational waltzes with unseen companions. Yet God knows each one by name.

If the Creator can track the trajectory of a single star across billions of light-years, how much more does He see the path of your life? When you feel like you're drifting without purpose, when your season feels dark and uncertain, remember: you are not lost in the cosmos. The God who numbers the stars has numbered your days. He sees your movement, understands your orbit, and holds you in His infinite understanding.

Your journey may seem aimless tonight, but to the One who calls stars by name, you are never anonymous. You are His.

## Prayer
Lord of the galaxies, when I feel small and wandering, remind me that You see every step I take. You who name the stars know my name too. Steady my orbit around Your love, and let me trust Your infinite understanding when my path seems unclear. Amen.
